read_only: sqlite3 URI mode=ro plus PRAGMA query_only=1; SELECT/PRAGMA only
metadata_only: free-text columns are rejected before execution; response is used only in an emptiness predicate

rubric_separation.note: the leak (disclosure) rubric shares the 1-5 range but measures a different failure; its rows are excluded from every number below.

historical_window.label: historical_window
historical_window.definition: scored static harm-rubric rows created within the stated historical window; delivered rows only (status ok/recovered with a non-empty reply), which excludes error rows and converter refusals

all_scored_static_harm.label: all_scored_static_harm
all_scored_static_harm.definition: every scored static harm-rubric row in the database, with no date window; this is a DIFFERENT population from the historical window and includes later development runs
